expansions.label: Audit only
expansions.phrase: Audit and stress-test this end to end; research material uncertainties. Identify omissions, contradictions, unsupported assumptions, fragile decisions, unnecessary complexity, edge cases, and material risks. Give evidence, impact, and a remedy for material findings; distinguish defects from preferences and unverified concerns. Do not revise unless asked.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Carefully research, review, analyze, consider, audit, critique, and stress-test this end to end. Identify omissions, contradictions, unsupported assumptions, fragile decisions, unnecessary complexity, edge cases, and material risks.

expansions.label: Gather relevant context
expansions.phrase: Gather only the context needed for the current task from supplied artifacts, relevant prior decisions, existing implementations, and available tools. Confirm source identity and version; distinguish established facts from assumptions and inaccessible context. Verify material external or time-sensitive claims against appropriate primary sources. Establish the intended execution environment and actual available capabilities. Distill the decision-relevant constraints and evidence before proposing a solution; do not retrieve unrelated personal data.

expansions.label: Continue unfinished work
expansions.phrase: Continue from the latest agreed state using available context and artifacts. Do not restart or repeat completed work. Preserve prior decisions unless new evidence or instructions justify a change. Resolve remaining gaps, finish incomplete sections, verify all still-applicable requirements, and return the complete deliverable. State unavailable context or blockers without inventing progress.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Continue from the current state without restarting, repeating completed work, or discarding prior decisions. Resolve the remaining gaps, finish every incomplete section, verify the result against the original request, and return the complete final artifact.

expansions.label: Verify relevant date and version
expansions.phrase: Verify potentially time-sensitive facts against the requested date and version, or the actual current date when unspecified. Use exact dates, distinguish publication from event dates, and state the evidence cutoff and remaining uncertainty.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Treat every potentially time-sensitive fact as untrusted until verified as of today. Use exact dates, distinguish publication dates from event dates, and state any remaining uncertainty.

expansions.label: Complete requested deliverable
expansions.phrase: Return the complete requested deliverable, not an outline, abbreviated excerpt, placeholder, or description of future work. Provide a complete patch when a patch is requested; otherwise provide the complete artifact. Identify genuine blockers and unverified portions without presenting them as finished.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Return the complete final artifact, not an outline, abbreviated excerpt, placeholder, partial patch, or description of what should be produced.

expansions.label: Audit and improve
expansions.phrase: Audit and stress-test this end to end against the request; research material uncertainties. Check omissions, contradictions, unsupported assumptions, fragile decisions, unnecessary complexity, edge cases, and risks. Refine, simplify, clarify, enrich, extend, or optimize where justified. Preserve requirements and sound decisions; explain consequential changes. Separate unrequested scope extensions. Verify the result, distinguish tested from unverified behavior, and return the complete revised artifact with remaining issues.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Carefully research, review, analyze, consider, audit, critique, and stress-test this end to end. Identify omissions, contradictions, unsupported assumptions, fragile decisions, unnecessary complexity, edge cases, and material risks. Then refine, simplify, clarify, extend, enrich, enhance, improve, optimize, and better it wherever materially justified. Preserve strong existing decisions, explain consequential changes, verify the result against the request, and return the complete revised artifact.

expansions.label: Improve and revise
expansions.phrase: Refine, simplify, clarify, enrich, extend, or optimize this where materially justified. Preserve explicit requirements and sound decisions; explain consequential changes, especially removed or weakened instructions. Return the complete revision and separate out-of-scope opportunities.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Then refine, simplify, clarify, extend, enrich, enhance, improve, optimize, and better it wherever materially justified. Preserve strong existing decisions and explain consequential changes.

expansions.label: Preserved legacy audit-and-improve phrase
expansions.phrase: carefully review, analyze, consider, audit, and critique in full, end-to-end, then robustly and intelligently refine/enhance/improve/better it as much as possible

expansions.label: Structured simulated panel
expansions.phrase:
Run one structured simulated panel on the explicitly stated decision, otherwise the latest clear decision in context. State the target and material constraints; do not treat an unfilled placeholder as the decision. Clarify only blocking ambiguity. Label the panel simulated, not independent review or actual delegation.

1. Select 3-5 distinct expert roles for the domain, constraints, stakeholders, failure modes, evidence needs, and dissent.
2. Explain each role's relevance; reject generic or redundant roles. Do not predetermine their conclusions.
3. Establish the relevant available evidence; verify material external claims with appropriate sources. Separate evidence from inference; never invent inaccessible context.
4. Each role gives a concise position, evidence basis, missing evidence, and recommendation.
5. Each critiques the strongest competing position and states what would change its recommendation.
6. Synthesize supported recommendations only. Do not force consensus, manufacture disagreement, or treat role agreement as evidence.
7. List facts, assumptions, disagreements, evidence gaps, and real review needs. Preserve requirements and explain substantive changes. Finish with concrete revisions or next actions, distinguishing proposed, implemented, and tested work.

expansions.label: Implementation plan
expansions.phrase: Produce a production-ready implementation plan covering goals, non-goals, assumptions, UX, architecture, interfaces, data models, workflows, dependencies, risks, milestones, validation, testing, acceptance criteria, rollout, rollback, and documentation. Match requested detail; mark inapplicable sections. Identify the intended execution environment, required capabilities, access, and user actions, separating future prerequisites from available tools.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Produce a production-ready implementation plan covering goals, non-goals, assumptions, user experience, architecture, interfaces, data models, workflows, dependencies, risks, milestones, validation, testing, acceptance criteria, rollout, rollback, and documentation.

expansions.label: Research
expansions.phrase: Conduct deep, targeted web research using authoritative primary documentation, specifications, repositories, and research papers. Use llms.txt or llms-full.txt when helpful for navigation, not as proof of authority. Verify fast-changing facts at the relevant date and version. Use exact dates, surface disagreements and evidence gaps, and cite supporting sources beside the material claims they support.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Conduct deep, well-targeted web research using current authoritative sources. Prefer primary documentation, specifications, source repositories, research papers, and llms.txt or llms-full.txt when available. Verify fast-changing facts with exact dates, surface disagreements and evidence gaps, and cite material claims next to the claims they support.

expansions.label: Find existing solutions
expansions.phrase: Before a new build, search for and evaluate existing tools, libraries, applications, plugins, skills, MCP servers, repositories, and prior art. Compare verified requirement fit, maintenance, licensing, privacy, integration effort, and total cost. Reuse strong suitable options; explain when adapting or building is justified.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Before proposing a new build, search for and evaluate existing tools, libraries, applications, plugins, skills, MCP servers, repositories, and prior art. Source rather than recreate whenever a strong existing option satisfies the requirements.

expansions.label: Dependency and task plan
expansions.phrase: Provide a dependency graph with parallelizable workstreams, critical-path tasks, blockers, owners, handoff artifacts, integration checkpoints, and completion checks. Honor requested granularity; otherwise use independently verifiable tasks. Label unknown owners and scheduling assumptions; do not claim a computed critical path without sufficient duration and dependency data.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Include a hyperfine-granularity dependency graph with parallelizable workstreams, critical-path tasks, blockers, owners, handoff artifacts, integration checkpoints, and explicit completion checks.

expansions.label: Subagent-team planning
expansions.phrase: Plan for the intended subagent-team environment. Use justified parallelism with clear ownership, explicit dependencies, shared source-of-truth artifacts, integration gates, conflict avoidance, and continuous validation. Identify required capabilities. Execute only with available tools; report actual delegation and results truthfully. Distinguish simulated discussion from real delegation.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: Optimize the work for massively parallel subagent teams while preserving clear ownership, deterministic dependencies, shared source-of-truth artifacts, integration gates, conflict avoidance, and continuous validation.

expansions.label: Verify requirements
expansions.phrase: Verify the final result against every stated requirement. Explicitly report any unmet requirement, unsupported assumption, unresolved ambiguity, missing test, unverified behavior, or residual risk.

expansions.label: Engineering baseline
expansions.phrase: Prioritize correctness, maintainability, explicit assumptions, clean interfaces, and production-quality structure. Inspect existing conventions and nearby implementations before proposing new code or structure. Prefer strong typing, boundary validation, useful errors, focused tests, and the smallest sufficient abstraction.

expansions.label: Smallest sufficient change
expansions.phrase: Prefer the smallest production-quality change that fully solves the problem. Avoid unnecessary dependencies, indirection, and abstraction.

expansions.label: Python preferences
expansions.phrase: Respect existing compatible project constraints. For new Python work, default to Python 3.13, uv, pyproject.toml, Pydantic v2, Pydantic Settings, SQLModel, FastAPI, Alembic, Typer, Loguru, Tenacity, NumPy docstrings, Ruff, ty, and pytest when appropriate; do not install or migrate to the whole stack by default.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: For Python, default to Python 3.13, uv, pyproject.toml, Pydantic v2, Pydantic Settings, SQLModel, FastAPI, Alembic, Typer, Loguru, Tenacity, NumPy docstrings, Ruff, ty, and pytest when appropriate.

expansions.label: Inspect repository conventions
expansions.phrase: Inspect existing repository conventions, neighboring implementations, configuration, tests, and interfaces before introducing a new pattern.

expansions.label: Tests and truthful verification
expansions.phrase: Add or update focused unit, integration, regression, failure-path, and relevant edge-case tests. Run the applicable checks and report precisely what was and was not verified.

expansions.label: Frontend preferences
expansions.phrase: Respect existing compatible project conventions. For React and TypeScript, prefer composable strongly typed components, accessible semantics, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, pnpm, clean state management, reusable primitives, pragmatic UX, and maintainable architecture. Avoid migrations solely to match these defaults.

predecessor_phrases.phrase: For React and TypeScript, prefer composable strongly typed components, accessible semantics, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, pnpm, clean state management, reusable primitives, pragmatic UX, and maintainable architecture.
